newsitem.title: UK: DuPont and CSC in $4.2 bln IT link - paper.
newsitem.headline: DuPont and CSC in $4.2 bln IT link - paper.

text.p: U.S. chemicals group DuPont Co has signed a technology outsourcing agreement with Computer Sciences Corporation worth $4.2 billion over 10 years, the Sunday Telegraph reported.
Under the terms of the deal, DuPont's 2,600 information technology staff worldwide will switch employment to CSC, the Californian IT group, it said.

The report added CSC was paying an undisclosed sum for DuPont's IT assets, which will then be leased back to the group. It said the deal was signed last Friday and would be formally announced this week.
